# Genetic enrichment

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
source("../R/output_gallery_helpers.R")
gallery_items <- check_output_gallery_assets(
  manifest_file = "output_gallery.yaml",
  gallery_root = "."
)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
render_gallery_section(
  gallery_items,
  "Genetic enrichment module",
  subsection_descriptions = c(
    "Single-nucleus chromVAR+SCAVENGE" = paste(
      "These plots show SCAVENGE trait relevance scores.",
      "The dotplot and boxplots summarize scores by cell type and GWAS trait,",
      "while the UMAPs show raw GWAS-specific trait relevance scores across individual nuclei."
    )
  )
)
```
